Legends meet again! DreamWorks How to Train Your
Dragon skins are coming soon!

New hero skins are here! Stoick the Vast takes on the
role of the Monk, uniting dragons and Vikings to
defend their homeland! Stoick, embodying
unmatched bravery and wisdom, is brought to life
straight from the beloved DreamWorks How to Train
Your Dragon universe. Unlock his exclusive skin now! 

Upgrade the skin to unlock stunning visual
transformations—Stoick will ride into battle atop
Skullcrusher, his steadfast and powerful Rumblehorn
companion! Witness this legendary duo charge
fearlessly into the fray, their strength and unyielding
bond inspiring all who follow. Don’t miss your chance
to add this iconic partnership to your collection! 

✅ Event Start Date: October 12th, 2026 
✅ Opening Server: 10001-10932
